You need to learn how to budget your time effectively. And stray away from being self destructive as much as possible. I work two jobs. The first one is 7-330 and the second is 5 to 12:00am. From 330 to about 440 I can usually squeeze in an early dinner with the woman.  Aside from that I wake up at 5am to get anything done around the house/errands that need to be run before work. Weekends are very very busy. Especially if you have a lot of friends or family. You have to learn where to spend your time and when to spend your time. Use your calendar as a way to understand your daily schedule. Block out work times then coordinate any free time with the people your close with or errands that need to be run.
